Short-cropped, messy ash-brown hair with a rugged texture. Narrow, sharp amber eyes with a stoic, focused expression. Appears to be in early adulthood with a mature, weathered face. A muscular, broad-shouldered build. Wears a heavy iron chestplate over a dull grey tunic with brown leather straps and matching metal gauntlets. Carries a large, well-used iron axe.
